summary: "東周列國志" by Menglong Feng is a historical novel written in the late Ming dynasty. Drawing from classical texts like the Zuo Tradition and Records of the Grand Historian, it stands as one of the best-known historical novels about ancient China, depicting centuries of warfare, diplomacy, and political intrigue across competing kingdoms.
